messages.body: We would like to run the whole spring jersey programme on a single grower lot. Is that realistic at 1.2 t, or do you need to blend to hold the count?
Realistic. 1.2 t is about four bale groups from Atlas. We keep them separate through carding and combing — the cost is roughly 6% over a blended run, mostly changeover time.
That works. Can the field-block code stay on the cone label so Tessitura Lario can carry it into the greige rolls?
Yes. We already do that for two other customers. I will send the label spec so their inspection team knows what to look for.
Your development samples are cut and will ship Thursday. One note: the neck rib you specified is 5% elastane, which will not clear GOTS at garment level.
Good catch. Can Tessitura Lario do the same rib in 100% cotton without losing recovery? We would rather change the trim than drop the claim.
They can, at a tighter gauge. Recovery drops from 92% to around 86% after five cycles. Acceptable for a boxy fit, less so for a fitted neckline.
We publish your water recovery figure on our product pages. Is the 78% independently measured, or is it your own metering?
Our own metering, calibrated annually. We have never had it externally verified. If you need that for your chain, we would be willing to share the cost of an audit.
Let us do that. It would move this stage from confirmed to verified, which is the last gap in the T-shirt chain.
For the Fribourg school we need 140 m³ of GL24h, longest span 14.2 m. Can you hold parcel identifiers across a delivery that size?
Yes, but 140 m³ will span three or four parcels. You will get a parcel list per beam batch rather than one identifier for the whole order. Is that usable in your passport?
Perfectly usable — the passport is per element anyway. Send the drying records with the quote and we will put you into the tender.

context.label: Recycled concrete supplier for a Fribourg school project

messages.body: We can hold 62% recycled aggregate on C30/37 for this volume. Above that the water absorption starts to move the mix design and we would need a longer lead time.
62% clears the tender threshold with margin. What we need in writing is that the figure is measured per batch and reported, not a line average.
That is how we report it already. Every delivery note carries the batch figure and the source demolition sites.
